headline: Indian markets focus on RBI MPC meeting, rising crude oil prices, and stock-specific actions

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Brent crude oil prices rising above $101 per barrel impacts market sentiment.
Investors are closely tracking the RBI MPC meeting and Governor Sanjay Malhotra's speech.
Gift Nifty and global market cues are setting the expectations for Nifty 50 and Sensex.
Markets previously saw strong momentum with Sensex settling 685 points higher on October 6.
whatHappening: Trent shares jumped 13% to hit a 2-year high following a strong Q2 operational update.
HCLTech, Ola Electric, Mahindra Lifespace, Godrej Consumer, and Blue Dart Express are listed as key stocks to watch.
Saudi East-West Pipeline moved 5.8 million barrels as the Red Sea route gradually recovers.
Pimco is betting on bonds as yields reach 24-year highs.
summary: Indian benchmark indices track key macroeconomic cues including the RBI MPC policy decision and elevated crude oil prices above $101. Trent leads corporate highlights following a 13% surge on strong Q2 updates. Stock-specific news surrounds HDFC Bank, HCLTech, and Godrej Consumer ahead of the trading session.
